text: PRE-REGISTERED RESULT (plan 69e64d5c2f02, frozen before any fold). 87/87 folds succeeded; the protocol audit returned CONFIRMATORY with no deviation. PRIMARY: the across-seed SD of complex_plddt is 2.6615 pLDDT units, pooled as sqrt(mean of per-candidate variances). H1 is therefore FALSIFIED against its pre-registered threshold of 2.0. The practical 2-SD resolution limit is 5.32 pLDDT units: any pLDDT difference smaller than that is not distinguishable from the sampler.

CONSEQUENCE for this project's own published comparison. Re-evaluating the 22 legacy-vs-real pLDDT deltas against the measured noise floor: 19 of 22 exceed 2 SD (4.1x to 17.4x) and are resolvable, so the finding that the legacy values overstated confidence STANDS and is now quantified. But the 3 deltas previously reported as agreement -- HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2 (+0.4), BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1 (+1.0) and MicroAutophagy-Tag-M4 (+3.4) -- are WITHIN NOISE at 0.1, 0.4 and 1.3 SD. No claim of agreement is licensed for those three; only that the difference is unresolvable.

H2 CONFIRMED. All 6 candidates returned bit-identical complex_plddt across 3 same-seed replicates, spread exactly 0.0. Seeding gives bit-reproducibility for single-chain folds on Apple MPS, which validates the --seed passthrough fix. The pre-registered caveat that Metal floating-point reduction order might break this did NOT materialise at this scale; it remains untested for larger jobs.

H3 CONFIRMED. Enabling the ColabFold MSA server shifted mean complex_plddt by 0.3306 pLDDT units, far below the 2.6615 unit seed noise, with a paired t-test across candidates at p = 0.978. Four of the six candidates were BIT-IDENTICAL with and without MSA, i.e. the search returned nothing usable for them. This is the expected result for hand-assembled motif concatenations, which have no natural homologues, and it means single-sequence mode costs this candidate set essentially nothing.

INTERFACE METRICS, measured separately as pre-registered. Across-seed SD: ipTM 0.09543, minimum interface PAE 3.1429 Angstrom, pTM 0.02618. The ipTM figure is large relative to the values it qualifies: the earlier pilot's three native replicates spanned 0.212-0.473, which is about 2.7 SD, so that spread was sampler noise rather than signal. Any ipTM comparison below roughly 0.19 (2 SD) is unresolvable on this hardware.

BUG FOUND AND FIXED while building this study. _write_boltz_input wrote the literal string 'msa: None' when the MSA was to be generated. Boltz silently ignores it and the run exits 0 in 2.8 seconds having produced nothing -- a success-shaped failure. The key must be OMITTED entirely; absent means generate. Verified: 43.6 s and real confidence output after the fix.
